７ Note
We'll walk through only a few of the alerts generated during the simulated attack.
Depending on the version of Windows and the Microsoft Defender XDR products
running on your test device, you might see more alerts that appear in a slightly
different order.


hierarchy.parent: Investigate the incident for the simulated attack
children: Alert: Suspicious process injection observed (Source: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint)
Alert: Unexpected behavior observed by a process run with no command-line arguments (Source: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint)
Alert: User and IP address reconnaissance (SMB) (Source: Microsoft Defender for Identity)
